This week two collegues and me applied for a landrover for the next field season. The grant is from the [Royal Geographic Society:](http://www.rgs.org/OurWork/Grants/Expedition+fieldwork+and+independent+travel+grants/Land+Rover+Bursary.htm) „The award is aimed at those who want to take a journey beyond their limits and boundaries, that offers chalenges for the team.“

To illustrate our motivation and that a good car is an essential part of our field work we created a video about our project.
